description: File a ready registration for carrier review, or resubmit one after a rejection. fees_acknowledged: true is the person's own acceptance of the carrier registration fees (separate from the per-text rate, a campaign billed for at least 3 months, non-refundable even if rejected); it is recorded with the time on the filed copy. The first submit for a business also carries the business attestation, signed by someone authorized to act for it, with the name they give. Both come from the person in this conversation. Our review can hold the filing for a person on our team; get the status afterwards.

attestation.description: Signed by someone authorized to act for the business, once per business: that they are authorized, that the details match the business's IRS records, and that the business will text only people who agreed to it and will follow the Messaging Policy. Kept as signed, with the exact wording, who sent it (the API key), the IP address, the user agent and the date of our legal documents.

accepted.description: Must be true: the person signing agrees to the statement.

signer_name.description: The full name of the person signing.

fees_acknowledged.description: Must be true. Confirms the registration fee terms above.
